# bolerish/edge

> A little more alive. Connect existing UI components to one shared directional light while keeping their markup, colors and interactions.

The React 19 adapter is @bolerish/edge. Import its stylesheet from @bolerish/edge/style.css. The workspace packages are private and not yet published to npm; see Installation for consumer commands and stylesheet setup, and CONTRIBUTING.md in the repository for local development. Dedicated Vue, Svelte and Solid adapters are not implemented.

Lighting creates a shared scope without adding DOM. Only explicit Lighting.Surface descendants respond; nested scopes are independent. Use useLight and useSurface to connect existing hosts, passing the callback ref returned by useSurface to the host. Keep your existing className and style; Edge owns its decorative bindings. Hooks add decoration after hydration; Lighting.Surface also emits decorative styles during SSR.

The edgeStyle option accepts raised, recessed and matte. The motion option accepts system (the library default), dynamic and static. staticDirection accepts a finite angle in degrees or "random", sampled once per light mount. The documentation site defaults to Dynamic and its Style and Motion controls update site preferences.

Decoration uses ::after by default. Select pseudoElement: "before" when ::after is occupied. Use wrappers for native inputs or hosts using both pseudo-elements. Lighting is decorative and does not replace focus, contrast or validation states. Position-only layout changes can require refresh(); rotated or perspective geometry and cross-document portals are unsupported. SSR and static rendering are supported; interactive tracking requires JavaScript. No performance advantage is claimed.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](/docs/): Shared-light concepts and scope.
- [Installation](/docs/installation/): Package manager commands, stylesheet setup and AI installation prompt.
- [Integration](/docs/integration/): Shared input-wrapper, decoration and layout constraints.
- [React usage](/docs/react/usage/): React components, hooks and existing-host bindings.
- [Style](/docs/styles/): Surface appearance values.
- [Motion](/docs/motion/): Input behavior, static direction and reduced motion.
- [Accessibility](/docs/accessibility/): Native controls, focus and forced colors.
- [React API reference](/docs/react/api/): Complete props, hooks, defaults and cleanup contracts.
